The athlete is currently in a fatigued state, indicated by the readiness score of 49 out of 100 and the overreach risk score of 58. This suggests that the athlete needs to focus on recovery and maintaining freshness leading up to the upcoming race. Monitor heart rate variability (HRV) and resting heart rate (RHR) to assess recovery status.

Consider incorporating active recovery methods such as light walking or swimming if allowed by the race conditions.
